title: The future of jazz
summary: Youngsters prefer rock and roll, but jazz will stay with the old musicians and spread abroad.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future

blocks.x: What do you think of the future of music?

Well... To tell you the truth, Tom... My people is going to rock and roll the youngsters. Look like they prefer that. Now there's some youngsters that like jazz. Because I can tell from those that I see out there at the hall. There's a lot of them come out there. But I think that jazz is the unfilled its foundation to stay. But there can always be some old musicians, some old jazz musicians around to play it.
What about in different parts of the world?
Covering the world, to tell you the truth about it...
